Generating or detonating a Wandering Vortex will also reduce nearby opponents' Anemo RES by 35% for 6s. 
Additionally, nearby party members who enter the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state while Song of Ages Past is in effect will have the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state extended by 4s.

skills.name: Dirge of the Fandyr
skills.description:
When the Elemental Skill Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn is used, Vodyanitsa will also gain 25 stacks of **Lead Vocal** as well as 10 stacks of **Chorus**.
The two effects above last 30s each, and the stack count is refreshed when the Elemental Skill is used.

skills.name: Echoes Over the Frozen Lake
skills.description:
Holding the Elemental Skill outside of combat will cause Vodyanitsa to embody her true Water Imp form and swim for up to 10s at the cost of Stamina. Naturally, as a Water Imp, she can also move across the water's surface. Vodyanitsa will exit her Water Imp form when the Elemental Skill is used again, when the duration ends, or when all Stamina is depleted.
Additionally, while Vodyanitsa can swim faster, her Stamina consumption rate is also increased.

skills.name: Heartless Siren Song
skills.description: As the Prima Donna of the Korolevskiy Troupe, Vodyanitsa sings in person in place of playing an instrument.

skills.name: Vila Blade Dance
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along her path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: The Art of Victory
skills.description:
Calls forth Spirit Blades passed down through generations of the Vila to deal AoE Anemo DMG, then switches to the **Armed for Action** mode and gains 2 stacks of **Sword Essence**.

Armed for Action
DMG dealt by Vesna with her Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks become Anemo DMG that cannot be overridden by another elemental infusion instead. She will also summon a wind pinion that attacks the opponent at the same time, dealing additional Anemo DMG. Each time the wind pinion is summoned, Vesna will regenerate a certain amount of Sword Essence.
Vesna can consume Sword Essence to unleash the special Elemental Skill **Windborne Sword**, which deals to the opponent Anemo DMG.
Each use of the special Elemental Skill Windborne Sword in the same instance of Armed for Action will increase the level of Windborne Sword, beginning from Lv. 1 to Lv. 3 max, for more Anemo DMG. Using Windborne Sword at Lv. 2 and Lv. 3 will also summon **Spirit Blades** which deal Anemo DMG.
Vesna will exit the mode when its duration ends or when she has used Windborne Sword at the highest level 3 times. Exiting will clear all remaining Sword Essence she has accrued.
Additionally, when in this mode, Vesna's resistance to interruption is increased.
Radiance: Stellar Swirl: DMG dealt with the Spirit Blades becomes Anemo DMG that is also considered Stellar Swirl reaction DMG.

Windborne Sword Lv. 3 Spirit Blade DMG

Windborne Sword Lv. 3 Spirit Blade Stellar Swirl DMG

skills.name: For the Tsaritsa!
skills.description: Summons multiple **Spirit Blades**, dealing AoE Anemo DMG. Also gains a stack of **Sword Essence**.

skills.name: Rite of Spring's Procession
skills.description:
After Vesna uses the special Elemental Skill **Windborne Sword** or the Elemental Burst **For the Tsaritsa!**, she also gains 1 stack of Disciplinary Action which lasts 20s. Max 6 stacks, and the duration of each stack is independent of the others'.
When she has Disciplinary Action stacks active, the **Spirit Blades** summoned by Vesna will deal DMG equal to (100% + 10% × Disciplinary Action stack count) of the original DMG instead. All active stacks of Disciplinary Action are cleared when Vesna uses the Elemental Skill The Art of Victory or when she leaves the field.

skills.name: Truth Prevails
skills.description:
Radiance: Stellar Swirl: Vesna will gain the corresponding effect based on the Elemental Type of her party members: 
· For every Cryo or Anemo character in her current party, Vesna's ATK increases by 6%; and
· For every character of all other Elemental Types in her current party, Vesna's Elemental Mastery increases by 25 instead.

skills.name: Stellar Jubilee: Splendid Prelude
skills.description:
When party members trigger Cryo Swirl, it will be changed to a Stellar Swirl reaction, and party members' Base DMG for the Stellar Swirl will be increased based on Vesna's ATK. Every 100 ATK she has increases the Base Stellar Swirl DMG by 0.7%. The maximum DMG increase that can be gained this way is 14%.
After a party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction nearby, Vesna enters the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state for 8s.

skills.name: The Grand Circuit
skills.description:
Holding on Sprint or Jump when Vesna is not in combat will cause her to enter the Coursing state.

Coursing
Continuously consumes Stamina to hover in mid-air. Sprinting or tapping Jump to go higher expends additional Stamina. Including the hold on Jump that triggers Coursing, Vesna can go higher up to 3 times in each instance of the Coursing state.

Additionally, in Snezhnaya (excluding Nod-Krai), when Vesna is switched onto the field while the currently active party member is in mid-air and not in combat, she will immediately enter the Coursing state and regenerate 50 Stamina. This effect can trigger once every 10s, and does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.

skills.description:
Follows his hunter's instincts. Tap or hold to produce different effects as well as apply the **Hunter's Mark** effect to the hit opponents.

Tapping
Fires at opponents in front of him, dealing AoE Electro DMG.

Holding
Enters aiming mode, then targets opponents within a certain area in front of him. Alyosha's Interruption RES is enhanced when in this mode.
At the end of the button hold, he deals Electro DMG to the targeted opponents.

skills.name: Hunter's Advance
skills.description:
Summons his trusted companion Tugarin to fight alongside him on the field. This also turns an area in front of him into a Fulgurite Hunting Field for a short time.

Fulgurite Hunting Field
· Continuously taunts nearby opponents to incite them to attack.
· Every 2s, deals an instance of AoE Electro DMG to any opponent that enters the field.

Tugarin
· If there are any opponents nearby, Tugarin will quickly move close to an opponent and maul them every 2s, dealing Electro DMG.
· If an opponent affected by the Hunter's Mark effect is hit, the Hunter's Mark will also be activated.
· Where there are multiple opponents, Tugarin will attack those affected by the Hunter's Mark effect first.

skills.name: Awakened by the Baying Hounds
skills.description: When **Tugarin** attacks, it will also restore HP to nearby active characters at 120% of Alyosha's ATK.

skills.name: Suffer the Winter Wheat Will
skills.description: Increases the DMG Alyosha deals with his Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst by 0.35% for every 1% of his Energy Recharge. Up to a 70% increase can be obtained in this way.

Alternates between the Plume and Wing dance moves, periodically attacking nearby opponents and dealing to them AoE Cryo DMG.
Additionally, for 6s after unleashing the Elemental Skill Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers, Odette's Elemental Skill Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers will become the special Elemental Skill **Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling****** instead, where a dance duet deals AoE Cryo DMG to nearby opponents over time. sections.title: What this sword rewards
paragraphs: Mistsplitter Reforged is a five-star sword with CRIT DMG as its secondary attribute and an elemental-damage passive. It suits evaluation on sword users who can activate its different conditions, rather than every character who likes critical hits. GameBreak comparison suggestion: use the same character, enemy and team buffs when comparing it with a sword you already own.

sections.title: Three separate emblem conditions
paragraphs: The passive tracks separate conditions: an elemental Normal Attack, using an Elemental Burst, and having less than full Energy. Their durations are independent. Repeating only one trigger is not the same as gaining all three conditions. Consult the in-game refinement level for numerical bonuses; this overview deliberately avoids treating one refinement’s values as universal.

sections.title: Availability and safe comparison
paragraphs: The linked official Epitome Invocation announcement confirms a historical weapon-event Wish featuring Mistsplitter Reforged. That announcement is an archive, not evidence of today’s banner. Check the current Wish item list and rules inside Genshin before spending currency. A character can still be played with other suitable weapons; owning this sword is not a requirement for using Ayaka’s mechanics.

sections.title: Inazuma weapon identity
paragraphs: The violet blade belongs to the Inazuma weapon series. Its description connects the reforged name to a blade that was once broken. The weapon page also separates its base appearance from its ascended appearance. Use those tabs to inspect the actual visual reference instead of assuming that a promotional character image always shows this exact equipped weapon.

sections.title: Damage checks that actually help
paragraphs: Practical checklist: compare an unbuffed hit and a fully prepared hit separately, note which passive conditions were active, and keep your critical-hit result consistent. Record Energy before and after the Burst. If an attack deals Physical damage, do not count it as an elemental trigger. This checklist is original testing guidance; no game-session verification is claimed here.

While in combat, this DMG Bonus will decrease by 10% per second until it reaches 0%. When the equipping character's Normal Attacks, Elemental Skills, or Elemental Bursts hit an opponent, the DMG Bonus for the corresponding DMG type is increased by 10% until it reaches 60%. This effect can be triggered once every 0.1s for each of the attack types mentioned above. This effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is off-field.
Additionally, when the party possesses Hexerei: Secret Rite effects, when the equipping character's Normal Attacks, Elemental Skills, or Elemental Bursts hit an opponent, the DMG Bonus for all these DMG types is increased by 20% instead.
